title: HTTP API design
description: HTTP semantics and OpenAPI conventions for teams maintaining client-facing contracts.

rules.instruction: Update the repository's OpenAPI contract for changed HTTP endpoints, including meaningful success and error responses.
rules.verification: Validate the specification and check contract tests against the implementation.

rules.instruction: Choose methods and status codes that match operation behavior. Document any retry or idempotency expectations.
rules.verification: Test success, input errors and repeated requests where retries are supported.

rules.instruction: Identify affected consumers and agree on a migration path before making a breaking contract change.
rules.verification: Record the migration decision and run compatibility checks for supported client versions.
